label: The lab virus is made with an antidote already prepared
description: Labs seen again with rats and vials, where the virus is being made such that it already has an antidote or vaccine ready. Given alongside the black horse riding out of Russia.
aliases: I saw labs again with rats but I saw vials
The virus has an antidote

label: Europe becomes the hot spot, not Iran
description: That attention should move off Iran and Israel and onto Europe, which is about to be the hot spot, with everyone's attention about to stop looking at the Middle East.
aliases: Europe's about to be the hot spot, not Iran
the attention should be more not so much on Iran

label: Zelensky is the puppet, not one of the four men
description: That the Ukrainian president was not among the four men he saw but was the puppet, a marionette with a long nose and a liar, manipulated by the four who are the backing for the missiles that are coming.
aliases: He was just the puppet
He's the marionette with the long nose, the liar
being manipulated by the four men

label: Man-made arson wildfires in Colorado and Canada
description: Wildfires in Colorado that he says were man-made arson, and things being set on fire in Canada, given alongside news of major wildfires in France which he says he did not see.
aliases: I saw wildfires in Colorado and they were man-made arson
they were catching things on fire in Canada

label: Gorilla genetics used to build super soldiers
description: Work to make men super strong by adding material from gorillas and other strong animals to build super soldiers, described as a race between China and other countries he says he was told not to name.
aliases: adding gorilla things like from big gorillas
trying to make men super strong
it was a race from China

label: Starlink rises in the Middle East with an atmospheric water machine
description: Starlink rising up in the Middle East, cited against Iraq granting it a licence, alongside a machine that pulls pure water out of the atmosphere and provides internet with it.
aliases: I said Starlink will rise up in the Middle East
pulling water out of the atmosphere for pure water

label: An Iraqi figure with a five o'clock shadow and a moustache
description: A man he says he described more than a year in advance as having a five o'clock shadow and a moustache, now identified in the Iraqi leadership signing deals in Washington.
aliases: He has a five o'clock shadow
the man has a five o'clock shadow with a mustache

label: The capped wells of revival open again at ORU
description: Wells of revival that had been capped opening again at Oral Roberts University, given alongside a call for revival in New York.
aliases: I see the wells of revival opening again at ORU
I see the capped wells coming open again

label: The Temple Mount decimated where the Dome of the Rock stands
description: The Temple Mount seen completely decimated where the Dome of the Rock is, though not uninhabitable, following the splitting of the Mount of Olives, with the trees given as the sign of the timing.
aliases: I saw the temple mount completely decimated
look at the trees for you'll know the time

label: A green cloak with Arabic writing covers Europe
description: A green cloak with white Arabic writing across it going over Europe and covering it, seen alongside a covenant with many being signed, a storm over Berlin and Iraq.
aliases: I saw a green cloak go over Europe
Arabic writing went across Europe with green on it

label: Banks turn to a crypto for cyber security against hackers
description: Bank of America and others seen going to a certain cryptocurrency for cyber security, asking for knowledge on how to stop hackers breaking into their databases. Distinct from banks-adopt-crypto-lending, which is the lending side.
aliases: they would try to go to a certain crypto
how to stop hackers from breaking into their database
